_comment: The external liveness check. /readyz, not /healthz: Google's front end swallows /healthz on a run.app URL and serves its own 404, so a check on it would fail forever. The body says 'ready' only when the database answered a ping, which makes this the one probe that sees the whole path. apply.sh lists by displayName before creating, so re-running it never creates a second check.
